thread:
emma: quick recap from today's all-hands Q&A about API/Console/Optimize timelines. dropping clarifying notes so folks can reference.

raj: thanks emma. can we get the short timeline for the Console feature parity items? customers asked for routing UI + template management dates.

emma: Console parity items split: routing UI (beta mid-Q3), template management (beta late Q3). GA windows: routing GA late Q3, templates GA early Q4.

katie: for templates, will there be migration from existing snippets? we have a bunch of saved prompt snippets in user accounts.

emma: templates will import snippets as "legacy templates" during beta opt-in. migration will be reversible during canary.

matt: Optimize question: when does automated batching recommendation join the console flow? we want a snippet to show in docs.

emma: plan: console will surface a recommended batch size in the route details in beta. the Optimize backend will offer suggested configs in canary (mid-Q3) and a one-click apply flow in GA.

raj: owners? who should we tag for comms?

katie: owners: lina for Console UI, michael for Optimize backend, raj for docs + comms.

ops-bot: reminder: canary checklist required; see https://internal.redwood/playbooks/canary-guide

emma: customers also asked about model compatibility for Optimize suggestions (quant+models). short answer: supported: decoder-only transformers FP16/INT8; experimental: 4-bit quantization on select opensource models. we'll expose compatibility flags in the UI.

matt: rollback criteria? what triggers abort during canary?

michael: rollback if p95 latency increases > 20% for 10 minutes, or if quality regressions exceed threshold on our prompt-set evals for two consecutive runs. cost regressions alone will not trigger rollback unless > 40%.

katie: action items for external comms:
- lina: UX screenshots + beta feature note by Tue EOD
- michael: publish canary gating doc + metrics by Thu
- raj: draft short customer-facing timeline blurb and API example by Fri

emma: sample API snippet for docs: `POST /v1/orgs/{org}/routes/{route}/suggestions/apply` body: `{"suggestion_id":"sugg-2819","mode":"preview"}`

lina: i'll add a mockup and include compatibility badges and the import flow for legacy snippets.

michael: starting perf telemetry integration today; will tag the canary PR when available.

emma: thanks everyone. i'll update the roadmap sheet after these deliverables are linked. closing thread unless there are blockers. :thumbsup:
